title: Chapter 314 - 314 Brother; You'Re Too Awesome!
content:
Chapter 314 - 314 Brother; You'Re Too Awesome!

Chapter 314 - 314 Brother; You're Too Awesome!

314 Brother; You’re Too Awesome!

After Zhu Yuanhui said these words, his expression became even more arrogant, and his nose was pointed so high up that it almost reached the sky.

He believed that this young man named Lin Fan knew what Little Tanuki Group, Penguin Group, and Alphabet Group represented.

At the same time, he would also understand the meaning of a market value of more than trillions!

He could almost see Lin Fan hunching over and begging him to buy his coffee beans.

Zhu Yuanhui was even considering whether he should lower the price later.

However, Zhu Yuanhui did not notice that Lin Fan’s face was full of mockery after he said those words.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang.

He looked at the caller ID, and a strange expression appeared on his face.

That was because the caller was the person Zhu Yuanhui had just mentioned, Chairman Zhang Daming.

In the eyes of outsiders, the internet was a very mysterious place.

However, in the eyes of professionals, there were no secrets.

Ever since Lin Fan obtained 5% of the shares of the Alphabet Group, Zhang Daming had been paying close attention to Lin Fan.

Soon, he found out that Lin Fan owned 5% of Penguin Group’s and Little Tanuki Group’s shares.

Gradually, Lin Fan’s shares in Penguin Group and Little Tanuki Group became 10%.

Not long ago, that figure reached 20%!

Lin Fan kept increasing his shares in Penguin and Ah-Ri, but would he increase his shares in Alphabet?

Zhang Daming did not know, but he had a vague guess in his heart.

Therefore, he had been a little anxious these days.

Finally, Zhang Daming mustered up his courage and called Lin Fan, trying to get close to him.

“Mr. Lin, how have you been?”

As soon as the call was connected, Zhang Daming’s hearty laughter rang out.

“I’m doing pretty well too. I’m doing just as well as the recent developments of our Alphabet! Mr. Lin, our Alphabet is preparing to launch a few more projects, but I wonder what the prospects are. I wonder if you’re free to come to Alphabet’s headquarters? It’s also good for us to check in with you,” Zhang Daming said.

Lin Fan was a smart person and naturally knew what Zhang Daming meant.

He waved his hand and said, “I won’t do that. Besides, I don’t know anything. I believe that you’ll develop Alphabet well.”

When Zhang Daming heard this, he was extremely happy.

However, he still said, “Mr. Lin, you’re too humble.”

At this moment, Lin Fan seemed to have thought of something and asked, “By the way, is Alphabet working with Magpie Coffee?”

Zhang Daming did not know why Lin Fan would ask this.

However, he still told the truth, “Yes, that’s right.”

Lin Fan said, “I planted a batch of good coffee beans. Zhu Yuanhui, the manager of the Southern Hua Nation region of Magpie Coffee, said that if I don’t sell them, he’ll make sure that my coffee beans won’t leave the mountain…”

Zhang Daming’s heart skipped a beat.

If Mr. Lin refused to sell the coffee, he would not be able to sell them outside the mountain?

Threatening Lin Fan? Someone actually threatened Lin Fan, who held 5% of Alphabet’s shares and 20% each of Little Tanuki and Penguin’s shares?!

Zhu Yuanhui… was really… bold!

How bold!

He had just said that Alphabet had a collaboration with Magpie Coffee. If Lin Fan misunderstood…

The consequences…

Zhang Daming’s heart jumped again, and he quickly said, “Mr. Lin, don’t worry. I’ll definitely get Magpie Coffee to give you a satisfactory answer!”

“Alright,” said Lin Fan.

Then, he hung up.

Zhu Yuanhui, who was standing at the side, sneered, “Alphabet? Could this be a call from the leader of Alphabet? Oh, no, no. According to your tone on the phone just now, you seem to be a senior executive of Alphabet.”

Lin Fan said lightly, “I was on a call with the chairman of Alphabet, Zhang Daming. However, I’m not a senior executive of Alphabet Jump. I’m just a shareholder.”

When Zhu Yuanhui heard Lin Fan’s words, he laughed out loud. “Hahaha! Bro, you really know how to brag! Zhang Daming? You, a shareholder? Hahaha!”

Lin Fan’s expression remained calm. He was about to say something when his phone rang again.

He looked at the caller ID and saw that it was President Ma from Penguin Group.

These days, Xiao Ma was always alone and worried.

Lin Fan had already raised his shares in Penguin to 20%.

With such a rapid increase in shares, Lin Fan would become the biggest shareholder of Penguin and the real boss! Xiao Ma also felt that it was possible.

As the chairman of the board, President Ma had only met Lin Fan twice and did not know his personality.

In President Ma’s opinion, this was a very dangerous thing.

Therefore, these days… President Ma had been looking for an opportunity to contact Lin Fan.

Today, he finally had an opportunity!

“Hello, Mr. Lin!” President Ma said.

Lin Fan said, “Hello, President Ma.”

He did not wait for the president to speak and said directly, “President Ma, does Penguin Group have a partnership with Magpie Coffee?”

When President Ma heard Lin Fan’s question, he was very happy.

He was not afraid of Lin Fan having too many questions for him, but he was afraid of not being able to communicate with Lin Fan.

He typed quickly on the keyboard, and soon, the information about Penguin’s cooperation with Magpie Coffee appeared clearly on the screen.

Hence, President Ma said, “Our Penguin Group owns 10% of Hua Nation’s shares of Magpie Coffee. In addition, the advertising and publicity of Magpie Coffee are all handled by us.”

President Ma briefly explained the situation in the form of a report.

“I planted some coffee in the mountains of Li City,” Lin Fan said. “Now, Zhu Yuanhui, the manager of the Southern Hua Nation region of Magpie Coffee, said that if I don’t sell it to him, he’ll immediately make sure that my coffee beans can’t leave the mountain.”

Penguin Group and Magpie Coffee had such deep cooperation.

However, Zhu Yuanhui, the South Hua Nation regional manager of Magpie Coffee, threatened Lin Fan?!

President Ma wanted to get closer to Lin Fan with this call!

Now… it was completely ruined!

Zhu Yuanhui was simply… a bastard!

President Ma stood up in anger and said seriously, “Mr. Lin, don’t worry. I’ll definitely get Magpie Coffee to give you a satisfactory reply.”

“Alright,” said Lin Fan.

After saying that, he hung up the phone.

Zhu Yuanhui could not help but laugh. “President Ma? Don’t tell me that the person who just called you was President Ma of Penguin Group? You’re not going to say that you’re a shareholder of Penguin Group, are you?”

Lin Fan raised his eyes and said, “I am.”

“Awesome, hahaha! Brother, you’re really too awesome, hahaha!” After Zhu Yuanhui heard that, he laughed so hard that he bent over.

He thought that Lin Fan would use another way to brag, but he did not expect him to use the same old trick.
